entries.name: OpenRouter (free models)
entries.offering: One API key for a rotating set of :free model variants, open-weight and stealth models among them

entries.name: Google AI Studio (Gemini API)
entries.offering: Free tier on the Gemini API, priced model by model rather than as one account quota

entries.name: Groq
entries.offering: Fast inference against a free plan Groq publishes as a per-model rate table

entries.name: Mistral Studio
entries.offering: Mistral's Free mode — no-card API access with an unpublished monthly allowance shared across Studio, API and the Vibe coding CLI

entries.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
entries.offering: Serverless model inference on Cloudflare, with an OpenAI-compatible API and a daily free allowance

entries.name: Ollama Cloud
entries.offering: Cloud-hosted open models with a monthly starter allowance advertised in the launch announcement; current pricing instead describes pay-as-you-go usage

entries.name: opencode
entries.offering: Open-source coding agent whose opencode Zen gateway prices a rotating set of models at zero — inside OpenCode only, no sign-in; any provider via BYOK

entries.name: Kilo Code
entries.offering: Open-source coding agent with an Auto Free mode and a keyless OpenAI-compatible gateway, alongside BYOK and local models

entries.name: TRAE (TraeCode)
entries.offering: Free plan of TRAE's AI IDE, TraeCode: Auto mode only, a one-time Basic usage allowance and limited autocompletion

entries.name: Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf)
entries.offering: Free plan of Cognition's desktop and terminal coding agents, alongside its paid plans

entries.name: GitHub Copilot Free
entries.offering: Free Copilot plan for individual developers in VS Code, JetBrains, Visual Studio and CLI; completions, limited chat and agent usage

entries.name: Google Jules
entries.offering: Free tier of Google's async cloud coding agent, on Gemini models; connects to GitHub repos and works autonomously

entries.name: Kiro
entries.offering: Perpetual free tier of AWS's spec-driven agentic IDE (successor to Amazon Q Developer) with Claude and open-weight models

entries.name: Cursor (Free)
entries.offering: Free coding plan of the Cursor AI IDE, with limited Agent and Chat usage

entries.name: Codex (ChatGPT Free)
entries.offering: Codex desktop access on a $0 ChatGPT Free plan, subject to rollout

entries.name: NVIDIA NIM (build.nvidia.com)
entries.offering: Free endpoints for the models build.nvidia.com marks "Free Endpoint", open-weight models from several labs among them, called with a free NVIDIA Developer Program key at integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1 (OpenAI-compatible)

entries.name: Z.ai (Zhipu GLM)
entries.offering: GLM Flash models free on the API, vision included (OpenAI-compatible at api.z.ai/api/paas/v4)

entries.name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
entries.offering: EU-hosted serverless API for open models, with anonymous OpenAI-compatible access and no signup, key or card

entries.name: Pollinations.AI
entries.offering: Legacy open text API, no signup, OpenAI-compatible (POST text.pollinations.ai/openai), on one model

entries.name: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (DashScope, international)
entries.offering: Model-specific free token grants in Singapore, typically one million tokens valid for 90 days; some models retain only previously issued allowances; OpenAI-compatible

entries.name: Upstage (Solar API)
entries.offering: Approved schools, universities, hospitals and nonprofits get free API model access for up to one year

entries.name: Cohere (trial keys)
entries.offering: Cohere's Command models via free trial API keys that never expire, plus a 30B/3B Apache-2.0 coding model Cohere prices at zero on every key type

entries.name: Qoder
entries.offering: A coding agent with a Free plan for basic models and an introductory Pro trial

entries.name: Vercel AI Gateway
entries.offering: OpenAI-compatible model gateway with recurring free credit after adding a payment method, plus separate zero-priced model routes

entries.name: Requesty
entries.offering: OpenAI-compatible router with free models beside a metered catalog, routing, caching and fallbacks

entries.name: Google Antigravity
entries.offering: Google's agent-first IDE and CLI, with a $0 Individual plan serving Gemini and third-party agent models

entries.name: SEA-LION (AI Singapore)
entries.offering: AI Singapore's OpenAI-compatible API for its Southeast Asian language models

entries.name: CodeGPT
entries.offering: VS Code / JetBrains coding agent whose $0 plan includes model usage rather than only BYOK — a small daily allowance on its own Economy models, plus BYOK across 15+ providers and local models (Ollama, LM Studio) beside it

entries.name: Inception Labs (Mercury)
entries.offering: A one-time signup token balance on Mercury diffusion models, including the current Mercury 3 chat model and earlier chat and code-edit models

entries.name: Dahl Inference
entries.offering: An OpenAI-compatible gateway to open models served by the Gonka decentralized GPU network — GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash and MiniMax M2.7 — whose sign-up asks for a username and nothing else and puts 100 million tokens in the account

entries.name: SenseNova (SenseTime 商汤)
entries.offering: SenseTime's SenseNova API, with a $0 Free plan during public beta; registration and identity verification required

entries.name: Hetzner Inference API
entries.offering: OpenAI-compatible API on Hetzner's own EU hardware, free for as long as the experiment runs

entries.name: Regolo AI
entries.offering: EU (Italian) zero-retention inference; a month of full model access on a daily token allowance, no card

entries.name: Freebuff
entries.offering: Ad-funded coding agent for CLI, desktop, web, cloud and chat, with daily regional allowances and conditional free-session access

entries.name: Qodo
entries.offering: Agentic PR code review plus Git and IDE integrations on a 14-day Pro Team trial with unlimited reviews and credits and no card

entries.name: CodeBuddy (Tencent)
entries.offering: Tencent's VS Code / JetBrains / CLI coding agent whose Free plan carries 100 credits a month, a daily activity bonus of 30 and 250 welcome credits, with every model open while the promotion runs — its site and the agent's own endpoint unreachable from the US, India and Russia

entries.name: FreeInference (Harvard SEAS)
entries.offering: Harvard SEAS's MadSys Lab serving open models free to every account behind both an OpenAI-shaped and an Anthropic-shaped endpoint, with a documented Claude Code setup

entries.name: OpenTyphoon (SCB 10X)
entries.offering: Thai-tuned open models from SCB 10X, the venture arm of Siam Commercial Bank, behind an OpenAI-compatible API whose FAQ calls it a research showcase and free to use

entries.name: IBM watsonx.ai (Lite plan)
entries.offering: IBM's watsonx.ai Runtime on its Lite plan — 300,000 tokens a month of foundation-model inference (Granite, Llama, Mistral and other hosted models) on IBM Cloud, a plan IBM's own docs call free and never bill

entries.name: Sail Research
entries.offering: Open-weight models for long-running agents — Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, DeepSeek V4 Pro — behind OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, with $5 of free credit every month once a payment method is on the account

entries.name: Sarvam AI
entries.offering: India's Sarvam AI grants verified users ₹100 in credits that never expire, spendable across its APIs, including Sarvam-105B chat through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint

entries.name: Standard Compute
entries.offering: A one-time $0.25 of smart-routed compute on a flat-rate agent gateway, no card — a real key on both wires, OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and an Anthropic Messages base Claude Code takes as it is

entries.name: RouterPlex
entries.offering: A one-time $1 of free credit on a prepaid reseller that bills its catalog at vendor list prices with 0% markup, no card — one key on both wires, OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and an Anthropic Messages base Claude Code takes as it is

entries.name: Cline
entries.offering: Open-source coding agent for VS Code, JetBrains, the terminal and Cline Desktop; signing in to its own Cline provider unlocks a rotating set of free models, each with a daily allowance, beside pay-as-you-go credits, the $9.99 ClinePass plan and BYOK

entries.name: Agnes AI
entries.offering: Agnes AI's own models behind an OpenAI-compatible API, with its Flash text models charged at zero today and image generation free beside them

entries.name: JetBrains AI (AI Free)
entries.offering: AI Free in JetBrains IDEs — unlimited code completion on JetBrains' own model and 3 AI Credits ($3) of cloud models every 30 days for chat and agents

entries.name: Zed
entries.offering: Open-source code editor with a hosted AI agent: a 14-day Pro trial with $5 of model usage and unlimited edit predictions, no card, plus a separate year of free Student access for verified university students

entries.name: LLM7.io
entries.offering: OpenAI-compatible API with a free dashboard token and a recurring allowance of 100,000 input plus output tokens per day on eligible turbo models

entries.name: Fireworks AI
entries.offering: Serverless inference on open-weight models with a $1 trial credit documented in the billing FAQ; current pricing no longer advertises a signup grant

entries.name: VLM Run Gateway
entries.offering: OpenAI-compatible gateway whose GPU-served vision and language models accept anonymous callers — no signup or key — in beta

entries.name: Tencent Cloud TokenHub
entries.offering: Tencent Cloud's model platform, with a one-time grant of a million tokens on each of its language models, valid a year and no card, on an account that has passed Tencent Cloud real-name verification

entries.name: Bytez
entries.offering: Serverless API over open models, whose Free plan grants $1 of credit every four weeks for open models of up to 7B parameters, one request at a time, with no billing

entries.name: Arli AI
entries.offering: OpenAI-compatible inference on open models and their fine-tunes, whose Free plan tries each model five times every two days at 12K tokens of context, one request at a time

entries.name: Mixlayer
entries.offering: Serverless open models priced per token, one of them at $0 and callable without prepaid credit

entries.name: abliteration.ai
entries.offering: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API for uncensored reasoning models, with a one-credit free preview and no card

entries.name: Impossibl
entries.offering: Prepaid gateway at provider list prices, Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and GLM among its models, whose keyless sign-up funds an account with $0.05 and adds $1 once a person claims it by email — no card

entries.name: The Grid
entries.offering: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible inference market with Free-account limits; signup-credit issuance is unconfirmed

entries.name: HPC-AI Model APIs
entries.offering: OpenAI-compatible inference with $2 of signup credit, or $4 in total with the vendor invite code, before any deposit

entries.name: Novita AI
entries.offering: Inference cloud with a zero-priced chat model through an OpenAI-compatible API, including tool calling and structured output

entries.name: SiliconFlow (China)
entries.offering: Zero-priced small chat models on SiliconFlow China, after real-name verification with accepted mainland, Hong Kong, Macau or Taiwan documents

entries.name: ModelScope API-Inference (Alibaba)
entries.offering: Alibaba model community with a free daily API inference allowance measured in credits, after Alibaba Cloud real-name verification

entries.name: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform express mode (formerly Vertex AI)
entries.offering: Google Cloud's express mode: an API key and 90 days of Gemini models within the free tier's quotas, with no billing information, for a new Google Cloud user on a @gmail.com account

entries.name: ZCode (Z.ai)
entries.offering: Z.ai's desktop coding agent, free as an app, with five days of its GLM models for a new user and no card

entries.name: Autohand Code
entries.offering: Open-source coding agent for the terminal, VS Code, JetBrains and the desktop whose Free plan runs Autohand's own latency-first coding model with no card, using recurring hosted-response credits

entries.name: Qoder CN (formerly Lingma)
entries.offering: Alibaba Cloud's coding apps for China, formerly Tongyi Lingma, with limited free usage and an introductory Pro trial

entries.name: Baidu Comate (文心快码)
entries.offering: Baidu's coding assistant for VS Code, JetBrains, Visual Studio and Xcode, with its own IDE and CLI; the free Personal Standard plan includes code completion and a one-time 5,000-point grant valid for seven days

entries.name: AtomCode
entries.offering: Open-source terminal coding agent from AtomGit, the code host run by CSDN and the Open Atom Foundation, whose sign-in claims a free 30-day coding plan, its quota counted in five-hour windows and its claims capped at a thousand a day

entries.name: MiniMax Code
entries.offering: MiniMax's coding agent — a desktop app for macOS and Windows, with an open-source CLI beside it — whose daily check-in in the app earns free points to spend on its tasks, coding among them

entries.name: Wallaby
entries.offering: OpenAI-compatible Kimi API from an Australian open-weight inference gateway, with $0.50 of signup credit and no card or initial payment

entries.name: Aion Labs
entries.offering: OpenAI-compatible text-model API with a daily credit allowance on its $0 Free tier, no card required

entries.name: SimpleLLM
entries.offering: OpenAI-compatible chat API from Stage One Solutions UG in Germany, with enabled zero-price aliases usable without credit

entries.name: IteraCompute
entries.offering: OpenAI-compatible API with recurring free usage on a self-hosted open model and an automatic router

entries.name: CodeRabbit
entries.offering: Code reviews for local Git changes through an installed CLI or VS Code extension, with an ongoing Free plan alongside a separate introductory trial

entries.name: Greptile
entries.offering: AI pull-request reviews on existing repositories with recurring Starter credits; installed CLI reviews use a separate no-card trial or a paid plan

entries.name: cubic
entries.offering: AI reviews for existing repositories, with an ongoing Free PR allowance and an included model for interactive local CLI reviews during alpha

entries.name: CodeAnt AI
entries.offering: Installed CLI for AI pull-request review and suggested fixes on existing code, with a no-card introductory trial

entries.name: Zro (MoonMath)
entries.offering: OpenAI-compatible inference for coding agents from MoonMath, with a recurring Free plan on selected Flash models

entries.name: Infron
entries.offering: OpenAI-compatible model gateway with a shared recurring Free request allowance, unlocked by a retained prepaid balance

entries.name: NoTrack API
entries.offering: Operator-hosted OpenAI-compatible API with a first-key trial budget for its single NoTrack Uncensored model

entries.name: Graphite
entries.offering: AI pull-request reviews and repository chat with an ongoing Hobby plan for personal GitHub repositories, alongside a separate no-card Team trial

entries.name: Sourcery
entries.offering: AI pull-request reviews, security checks and suggested fixes for public repositories, with a separate no-card trial for private repositories

entries.name: DeepSource
entries.offering: AI code review and suggested fixes on existing repositories, with a no-card introductory trial and bundled AI Review credits

entries.name: Liquid Inference
entries.offering: Inference exchange where providers compete to serve API requests, with a no-card starting credit for new workspaces

entries.name: LLM.kiwi
entries.offering: Hosted OpenAI-compatible API with a no-card Free plan and an automatic model router

entries.name: Summer Engine
entries.offering: Desktop game editor with a one-time, no-card credit for AI edits to scripts and scenes

entries.name: Codacy
entries.offering: AI pull-request reviews for public open-source GitHub repositories, with a separate no-card trial for private repositories

entries.name: Mixedbread
entries.offering: OpenAI-compatible API for the Toast 1 knowledge and search model, with one-time Starter credit and no card required

entries.name: Merkium
entries.offering: Independent model developer with a free OpenAI-compatible API and chat service; current API models have no per-request or per-token charge

entries.name: PLaMo API (Preferred Networks)
entries.offering: Preferred Networks model API with a Free plan for eligible users in Japan

entries.name: Teapot Router
entries.offering: Independent API gateway with a one-time signup credit grant and optional prepaid use

entries.name: AMD Radeon Cloud Token Factory
entries.offering: Free shared model API on AMD Radeon GPUs, with a recurring account-specific daily usage allowance

entries.name: iFlytek Spark Lite (讯飞星火)
entries.offering: Free Spark Lite HTTP API

entries.name: Volcengine Ark (new-user inference trial)
entries.offering: No-card online inference trial for new accounts

entries.name: Together AI (free model)
entries.offering: Zero-priced serverless chat after activation
